label: GO step late in the episode (trials 90+) after a rewarded trial, when choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (98% of mass in trials 90-99, none before 80), equivalently when the value head is low (<5.2, 99.6% of mass), and almost only after a rewarded previous trial (98% of mass). Within that it strongly prefers an a1 choice (93% of mass): policy logit choice > 2 (the agent own computed upcoming choice, used instead of the FUTURE action variable; action == 1 scores about the same, F1 0.75 dev). Magnitude ramps up with episode position toward trial 99 and across consecutive rewarded a1 trials; weak activations occur on a2 choices very late in the episode. Never fires at D1/D2, after unrewarded trials (rare), or before trial 80. Dev: P 0.82, R 0.70, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.89. Dropping the choice condition gives recall 0.92 but precision 0.45. Looks like an end-of-episode timer gated by reward and a1 preference.
